The good shepherd, John 10. Jesus said I am the good shepherd, the sheep know my voice, and I give my life for the sheep, and I have other sheep, not of this fold, and them also I must bring, and one fold, and one shepherd. A hired hand can run, but a good shepherd stays. You are not a nameless face to Jesus. You are known, and He is the door to safe pasture. Listen for His true voice, not a stranger.
